covers.what: finalize, and the session_start, message_end, agent_settled and session_shutdown handlers

checks.name: faithful
checks.why: Pi as it is: /reload can run while agent_settled handlers still run. Finding F1 in README.md.

checks.name: no-reload-during-settle
checks.why: Assume that /reload waits for agent_settled to end. Every other property must hold.

checks.name: no-reload-during-settle-wide
checks.why: The same assumption at wider bounds: 3 jobs, 2 reloads, 3 user runs or aborts.

checks.name: mutant-send-ignores-binding
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:71 without `runtime.delivery !== binding`: a read that started before a reload sends through the old binding

checks.name: survivor-start-ignores-busy
checks.why: The ctx.isIdle() check of reconcile (lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:121) removed. In the model reconcile never runs during a run: agent_settled comes after the run, and Pi refuses /reload while isStreaming. The check guards compaction, which the model leaves out.

checks.name: mutant-reconcile-ignores-outbox
checks.mirrors: lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:132 without `|| runtime.outbox.has(job.id)`: reconcile counts an attempt for a send that is still in flight

checks.name: mutant-claim-unchecked
checks.mirrors: extensions/shell-jobs.ts:204 without `done.claimed` and lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:73 without `latest.claimed`: a job that the user killed gets a completion

checks.name: mutant-finalize-ignores-claim
checks.mirrors: extensions/shell-jobs.ts:204 without `done.claimed`: finalize counts an attempt for a job that the user killed. sendCompletion still drops the send (lib/shell-jobs-delivery.ts:73), so only the count breaks

checks.name: survivor-reconcile-history
checks.why: The history lookup of reconcile removed. In the model a message lands only while attached, so message_end always acknowledges it first. The lookup guards cases outside the model: a restart hand-over and a lost message_end.
